question: dame el volumen liquidado en euros de cada mes, ordenado por mes
sql:
SELECT
  d.month_name,
  d.iso_year,
  SUM(s.gross_eur_minor) AS gross_eur_minor
FROM fact_settlement_batch s
JOIN dim_date d ON s.settlement_date = d.full_date
GROUP BY
  d.month_name,
  d.iso_year,
  d.month
ORDER BY
  d.month
